result.title: This Robot Is Unlike Any Other On The Market
result.description:
This week I discovered the Flourish 1, a $3,500 robot that uses a Raspberry Pi instead of expensive hardware and can learn household chores just by watching you move your phone.

It focuses on practical tasks instead of flashy features, and the price reflects that.

Only 50 are being made in the first batch with shipping planned for December.

Would you rather get this instead of an ultra advanced $20,000 robot? 

#Robotics #FutureTech #AI #AInews
